name: uep-public-testnet-marketplace
description: Public reproducible UEP testnet: hardened core, Marketplace and IoT/M2M, plus research labs (consensus, ZK/Groth16 dev circuit, agents, service API).

scripts.test: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:marketplace && npm run test:settlement && npm run test:oracle && npm run test:category
scripts.test:all: npm run lint:determinism && npm run check:snapshot-compat && npm run check:donation && npm test && npm run test:poisoned-clock && npm run smoke:testnet && npm run quickstart && npm run simulate:20k && npm run test:rust && npm run build:uep-zk && npm run test:lab
scripts.test:protocol: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/testnet/*.test.ts src/identity/*.test.ts src/core/uep-smt-key-hardening.test.ts src/core/poseidon.test.ts src/core/smt-compressed.test.ts src/core/asset-registry.test.ts src/core/height.test.ts src/core/deterministic-transitions.test.ts
scripts.test:marketplace: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/marketplace/*.test.ts src/service/iot-m2m.test.ts src/service/iot-mars-delay.test.ts src/service/compat-shims.test.ts src/service/uep-http-authz.test.ts src/service/height-producer.test.ts src/service/poisoned-clock.test.ts
scripts.test:poisoned-clock: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --import ./scripts/poisoned-clock-preload.mjs --test src/testnet/*.test.ts src/marketplace/*.test.ts src/service/iot-m2m.test.ts src/service/iot-mars-delay.test.ts src/service/compat-shims.test.ts src/service/uep-http-authz.test.ts src/service/height-producer.test.ts src/settlement/*.test.ts src/category/*.test.ts src/oracle/*.test.ts
